terminologyProfile.descriptionRule: Use measurable 3D object-space terms and evidence refs.

referenceCamera.note: Three orthographic-like exterior views constrain proportions. Hidden blade coupling, motor and lid lock remain inferred.

objectClass.notes: Front, side and back establish the exterior. The motor, wiring, coupling and locking structures are hidden and explicitly inferred or omitted.

reasoning: The tapered transparent jar, curved loop handle, four-blade assembly, two-band enclosure, repeated ribs and vents, controls and powered vortex require a complex action-ready hierarchy.

specDepthDecision.rationale: Visible identity depends on nested jar, lid, blade, handle, control and rear-service systems.

detailInventory.note: All visible details map to named component features or material overrides. The powered liquid cue is explicitly inferred.

details.description: Low mint cylindrical lid knob with softened upper rim.
Broad shallow Sakura-pink lid dome with a soft crown.
Thin projecting lid flange overlaps the jar rim.
Translucent pink collar continues below the lid.
Transparent jar widens upward and narrows toward the blade floor.
Eight tall molded relief ribs follow the jar taper.
Thick cream closed handle forms a tall rounded rectangular opening.
Four dark metal blades cant upward around a central hub.
Shallow pink jar seat separates vessel from motor base.
Warm cream upper motor enclosure tapers inward toward the jar.
Sakura-pink lower enclosure has a wide rounded footprint.
Straight horizontal cream-to-pink enclosure seam.
Large layered mint circular speed dial projects from the front.
Narrow vertical marker is recessed into the dial face.
Small circular status lens sits above the speed dial.
Five horizontal rounded vent slots occupy the rear cream panel.
Dark two-pin inlet is centered low on the rear pink panel.
Four shallow dark rubber feet support the base.
Jar edges and ribs carry brighter low-roughness highlights than the center.
Powered-only smoothie vortex and ingredient spiral communicate blending.

definitionOfDone: The browser model matches the three-view jar-to-base proportions, tapered silhouettes, loop handle negative space, four-blade assembly, pastel material zoning and rear service details, and unmistakably blends ingredients during the 5.2 second powered cue.

featureGroups.name: Rounded shell proportion
qualityCriteria: Height/width 1.12 and depth/width 0.72 with broad corner radii.

featureGroups.name: Eight-ring bubble wheel
qualityCriteria: Exactly eight rings and eight spokes rotate around a centered front axis.

featureGroups.name: Side liquid reservoir
qualityCriteria: Translucent right-rear tank remains attached from side and back.

featureGroups.name: Rear fan and grille
qualityCriteria: Rotor is visible behind concentric grille geometry and four fasteners.

featureGroups.name: Powered purpose animation
qualityCriteria: Control, wheel and fan rotate while bubbles rise and spread, then exact reset at 5.2 seconds.

antiShallowSpecRules: No flat texture replacement for wheel or grille.

mustMatch: broad pink domed lid and mint knob
cream loop handle with large negative space
cream upper and pink lower tapered base
large mint dial with marker and status dot
four metal blades, jar ribs, rear vents and inlet
reference-derived material separation and clear powered vortex

screenshotPolicy.minimumEvidence: render screenshot, side-by-side comparison, AI vision score and feature scores
